prompt: A sober editorial illustration set outside a sleek, glass-fronted OpenAI headquarters in San Francisco: an older gray-haired woman in ordinary activist clothes sits peacefully on the floor before chained, padlocked entrance doors, holding a small sign reading “PAUSE AI” while police officers stand nearby and office workers are visibly unable to enter; behind the glass, glowing server racks and an abstract towering AI face suggest the feared race toward superintelligence, while in the foreground a courthouse scale balances a protest placard and a set of handcuffs, with a jail door closing in the background—visually framing the conflict between warnings about AI risk, nonviolent civil disobedience, disruption to others, and the legal consequences of a blockade.
